section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Willow Lane Cohort.

Table 6. Results for each arm and measure, split by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
